title: Two confounds in reported fusion gains for airborne mineral exploration
description: Reproducible airborne multi-modal mineral-exploration benchmark: real USGS radiometrics + real ASTER L1T thermal infrared + real aeromagnetics + USGS SIM 3206 geology, with a documented synthetic EM augmentation. Separates target circularity from the conditioning effect of an underdetermined inversion and provides a model-free information test.
